source: 48.rom as SkoolKit 10.1 ships it, sha1 5ea7c2b824672e914525d1d5c419d71b84a426a2 (the same file as ZEsarUX 13.0's 48.rom)
why: Collecting a rig (C) reads the gas the rig tapped from the table that ($87A3) points to, one byte per area. The pointer is set when the first rig of a game is placed; Amethyst starts with its sector marked (its byte at $877B is 1), so a C pressed there before any rig has been placed reads with the pointer still 0: the byte at $0000 plus the area less one, the ROM's first byte, $F3.
